recipes.name: Crispy sesame tofu with broccoli
recipes.blurb: Cornstarch-dusted tofu turns golden and shatteringly crisp under a glossy soy-sesame glaze.
steps: Press the tofu between paper towels for 15 minutes, then cut into 1-inch cubes and toss with the cornstarch until evenly coated.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large nonstick pan over medium-high and fry the tofu, turning, until golden and crisp on all sides, about 8 minutes. Remove to a plate.
Steam or blanch the broccoli florets until just tender, about 3 minutes, then drain.
Whisk the soy sauce, rice vinegar, maple syrup, garlic, ginger, and sesame oil into a sauce.
Pour the sauce into the hot pan and simmer until it thickens slightly, about 1 minute, then return the tofu and broccoli and toss to coat.
Scatter with sesame seeds and serve over rice.

recipes.name: Smoky tempeh tacos
recipes.blurb: Crumbled tempeh simmered in chipotle and lime makes a hearty, protein-packed taco filling.
steps: Crumble the tempeh with your hands into rough pea-sized pieces.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium and soften the chopped onion for 4 minutes, then add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the tempeh, smoked paprika, and cumin and cook until the tempeh browns, about 6 minutes.
Stir in the chopped chipotle, a splash of water, and the juice of half the lime, then simmer 3 minutes.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan, fill with the tempeh, and top with sliced avocado, cilantro, and a squeeze of remaining lime.

recipes.name: Palak paneer
recipes.blurb: Soft cubes of paneer folded into a velvety, lightly spiced spinach gravy.
steps: Blanch the spinach in boiling water for 1 minute, drain, cool under cold water, then blend to a smooth puree.
Cube the paneer and lightly fry in 1 tablespoon butter until golden at the edges, then set aside.
Melt the remaining butter and cook the cumin until fragrant, then add chopped onion and cook until soft.
Stir in the garlic, ginger, and chopped tomato and cook until the tomato breaks down, about 6 minutes.
Add the turmeric and garam masala, then stir in the spinach puree and simmer for 5 minutes.
Fold in the paneer and cream, warm through, and season with salt before serving.

recipes.name: Mushroom and white bean ragout
recipes.blurb: Meaty mixed mushrooms and creamy cannellini beans in a thyme-scented pan sauce.
steps: Heat the olive oil in a wide pan over high and sear the sliced mushrooms undisturbed until deeply browned, about 6 minutes.
Lower the heat, add the chopped shallot and garlic with the thyme, and cook 2 minutes.
Pour in the wine and simmer until nearly evaporated, scraping up any browned bits.
Add the drained beans and broth and simmer until the sauce thickens slightly, about 8 minutes.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon and chopped parsley, and serve over toast or polenta.

recipes.name: Chana masala
recipes.blurb: Chickpeas simmered in a tangy tomato-onion gravy bright with amchur and garam masala.
steps: Heat the oil and cook the cumin seeds until they crackle, then add finely chopped onion and cook until golden, about 8 minutes.
Stir in the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then add the grated or chopped tomato and cook until jammy, about 8 minutes.
Add the turmeric, coriander, garam masala, and amchur and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Tip in the drained chickpeas with 1 cup water and simmer for 12 minutes, mashing a few chickpeas to thicken the gravy.
Season with salt, finish with cilantro, and serve with rice or flatbread.

recipes.name: Red lentil dal
recipes.blurb: Silky red lentils with a sizzling cumin-and-garlic tarka poured over the top.
steps: Rinse the lentils, then simmer with the turmeric, chopped tomato, and 4 cups water until soft and broken down, about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season the dal with salt and whisk briefly to make it creamy, adding water to loosen if needed.
Heat the coconut oil in a small pan and fry the cumin seeds until they pop, then add chopped onion and cook until golden.
Add the garlic and ginger to the pan and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour the sizzling tarka over the dal, stir through, and finish with lemon juice and cilantro.

recipes.name: Stuffed portobello mushrooms
recipes.blurb: Big mushroom caps filled with garlicky spinach, sun-dried tomato, and crisp breadcrumbs.
steps: Heat the oven to 400F and remove the stems and gills from the mushroom caps, then brush all over with olive oil.
Wilt the spinach with the garlic in a hot pan, then chop with the sun-dried tomatoes.
Mix the spinach mixture with the breadcrumbs, half the parmesan, and a drizzle of oil.
Pile the filling into the caps, top with the remaining parmesan, and arrange on a lined sheet pan.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes until the mushrooms are tender and the topping is golden, then finish with torn basil.

recipes.name: Black bean and sweet potato enchiladas
recipes.blurb: Soft tortillas rolled around spiced sweet potato and black beans under a smoky red sauce.
steps: Heat the oven to 400F and roast the peeled, diced sweet potato with oil, cumin, and paprika for 25 minutes until tender.
Soften the chopped onion in a pan, then stir in the drained black beans and the roasted sweet potato, mashing slightly.
Spread a thin layer of enchilada sauce in a baking dish.
Fill each tortilla with the bean mixture, roll up, and place seam side down in the dish.
Pour the remaining sauce over the top, scatter with cheese, and bake for 20 minutes until bubbling.
Finish with cilantro before serving.

recipes.name: Coconut chickpea curry
recipes.blurb: A quick, creamy curry of chickpeas and spinach in fragrant coconut and tomato.
steps: Heat the oil and soften the chopped onion for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger, and curry powder and cook 1 minute.
Add the diced tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes until slightly reduced.
Stir in the drained chickpeas and coconut milk and simmer gently for 12 minutes.
Fold in the spinach until wilted, then season with salt and a squeeze of lime.
Serve over rice or with naan.

recipes.name: Tofu pad thai
recipes.blurb: Springy rice noodles tossed with crispy tofu, peanuts, and a sweet-tangy tamarind sauce.
steps: Soak the rice noodles in hot water until pliable, then drain.
Whisk the tamarind paste, soy sauce, and brown sugar with 2 tablespoons water to make the sauce.
Fry the cubed tofu in oil until golden, then push to one side and scramble the eggs.
Add the garlic and noodles, pour in the sauce, and toss over high heat until the noodles soften and absorb the sauce.
Stir in most of the bean sprouts and scallions, then plate and top with peanuts, the remaining sprouts, and lime wedges.

recipes.name: Lentil shepherd's pie
recipes.blurb: Savory braised lentils and vegetables under a cloud of golden mashed potato.
steps: Simmer the rinsed lentils in plenty of water until just tender, about 20 minutes, then drain.
Boil the peeled, chopped potatoes until soft, then mash with 2 tablespoons olive oil and salt.
Heat the remaining oil and soften the diced onion, carrot, and celery for 8 minutes, then stir in the tomato paste and thyme.
Add the lentils, broth, and peas and simmer until thickened, about 8 minutes, then season well.
Spread the filling in a baking dish, top with the mash, and rough the surface with a fork.
Bake at 400F for 25 minutes until the top is golden.

recipes.name: Miso-glazed eggplant
recipes.blurb: Soft, custardy eggplant lacquered with a sweet-savory miso glaze and broiled until caramelized.
steps: Halve the eggplants lengthwise and score the cut sides in a diamond pattern.
Brush the cut sides with sesame oil and roast at 425F for 20 minutes until soft.
Whisk the miso, mirin, maple syrup, and rice vinegar into a smooth glaze.
Spread the glaze over the eggplant and broil for 3 to 4 minutes until bubbling and caramelized.
Garnish with sliced scallions and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Chickpea shawarma bowls
recipes.blurb: Crisp spiced chickpeas over fluffy grains with tahini drizzle and quick-pickled onions.
steps: Heat the oven to 425F and toss the drained chickpeas with oil, cumin, coriander, paprika, and turmeric, then roast for 25 minutes until crisp.
Cover the couscous with an equal volume of boiling water, cover, and let stand 5 minutes, then fluff.
Thinly slice the red onion and toss with the juice of half the lemon and a pinch of salt to quick-pickle.
Whisk the tahini with the remaining lemon juice and enough water to make a pourable sauce.
Build bowls with couscous, chickpeas, sliced cucumber, and pickled onion, then drizzle with tahini sauce.

recipes.name: Greek salad
recipes.blurb: Sun-ripe tomatoes, cucumber, and creamy feta dressed simply in olive oil and oregano.
steps: Cut the tomatoes into wedges and the cucumber into thick half-moons.
Thinly slice the red onion and bell pepper.
Combine the vegetables and olives in a wide bowl.
Whisk the olive oil, vinegar, and oregano with a pinch of salt and pour over.
Top with a slab of feta, drizzle with a little more oil, and serve.

recipes.name: Quinoa tabbouleh
recipes.blurb: A herb-forward, lemony grain salad with quinoa standing in for bulgur.
steps: Rinse the quinoa, then simmer in 2 cups water until tender and the grains uncurl, about 15 minutes, and let cool.
Finely chop the parsley, mint, tomatoes, cucumber, and scallions.
Combine the cooled quinoa with the herbs and vegetables.
Dress generously with lemon juice, olive oil, and salt, then taste and adjust the lemon.

recipes.name: Crunchy Asian slaw
recipes.blurb: Shredded cabbage and carrot in a punchy sesame-ginger dressing with toasted almonds.
steps: Finely shred both cabbages and the carrots, and slice the scallions.
Toast the sliced almonds in a dry pan until golden, then set aside.
Whisk the soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, maple syrup, and ginger into a dressing.
Toss the vegetables with the dressing and let sit 10 minutes to soften slightly.
Top with the toasted almonds just before serving.

recipes.name: Roasted beet and goat cheese salad
recipes.blurb: Sweet roasted beets, tangy goat cheese, and toasted walnuts over peppery greens.
steps: Wrap the beets in foil and roast at 400F for 45 minutes until tender, then cool, peel, and cut into wedges.
Toast the walnuts in a dry pan until fragrant.
Whisk the olive oil, balsamic vinegar, and honey with a pinch of salt.
Toss the arugula with most of the dressing and pile onto plates.
Top with the beets, crumbled goat cheese, and walnuts, then drizzle with the remaining dressing.

recipes.name: Caprese salad
recipes.blurb: Layers of ripe tomato, fresh mozzarella, and basil finished with good olive oil.
steps: Slice the tomatoes and mozzarella into rounds of similar thickness.
Arrange them alternating on a platter, tucking basil leaves between the slices.
Drizzle with olive oil and a little balsamic glaze.
Season with flaky salt and black pepper and serve right away.

recipes.name: Farro and roasted squash salad
recipes.blurb: Chewy farro with caramelized butternut, dried cranberries, and a maple-mustard dressing.
steps: Cook the farro in salted water until tender and chewy, about 25 minutes, then drain and cool.
Roast the peeled, cubed squash with 1 tablespoon oil at 425F for 25 minutes until caramelized.
Toast the pecans in a dry pan until fragrant, then roughly chop.
Whisk the mustard, maple syrup, vinegar, and remaining oil into a dressing.
Toss the farro, squash, cranberries, pecans, and arugula with the dressing and season to taste.

recipes.name: Classic coleslaw
recipes.blurb: A creamy, tangy cabbage slaw that is the perfect crunchy partner to anything off the grill.
steps: Finely shred the cabbage and grate the carrots into a large bowl.
Whisk the mayonnaise, vinegar, mustard, sugar, and celery seed with a good pinch of salt.
Pour the dressing over the vegetables and toss until evenly coated.
Chill for at least 20 minutes to let the flavors meld before serving.

recipes.name: Warm lentil and feta salad
recipes.blurb: Earthy green lentils tossed warm with roasted peppers, herbs, and salty feta.
steps: Simmer the rinsed lentils in salted water until tender but holding shape, about 22 minutes, then drain.
Whisk the lemon juice, mustard, and olive oil into a dressing.
While the lentils are warm, toss them with the dressing.
Fold in the chopped roasted peppers, thinly sliced red onion, and parsley.
Crumble the feta over the top and serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.name: Watermelon and feta salad
recipes.blurb: Juicy watermelon, salty feta, and mint with a lime drizzle for a hot-day refresher.
steps: Arrange the cubed watermelon on a platter.
Scatter over the crumbled feta, thinly sliced red onion, and torn mint.
Squeeze the lime over the top and drizzle with olive oil.
Finish with a little flaky salt and serve chilled.

recipes.name: Kale Caesar with crispy chickpeas
recipes.blurb: Massaged kale in a creamy vegan Caesar with crunchy roasted chickpeas instead of croutons.
steps: Toss the drained chickpeas with olive oil and salt and roast at 425F for 25 minutes until crisp.
Whisk the tahini, lemon juice, mustard, grated garlic, chopped capers, and nutritional yeast with water to a pourable dressing.
Strip the kale from the stems, tear into pieces, and massage with a little dressing until softened.
Toss the kale with the rest of the dressing.
Top with the crispy chickpeas just before serving.

recipes.name: Caprese-style panzanella
recipes.blurb: Crusty bread soaked in tomato juices with mozzarella, basil, and a sharp vinaigrette.
steps: Toss the bread cubes with a little oil and toast at 400F for 10 minutes until golden but still chewy.
Cut the tomatoes into chunks, salt them, and let sit 10 minutes to release their juices.
Whisk the vinegar, remaining olive oil, and grated garlic into a vinaigrette.
Combine the bread, tomatoes with their juices, sliced cucumber, and torn mozzarella.
Pour over the vinaigrette, fold in the basil, and let stand 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Spiced carrot and chickpea salad
recipes.blurb: Ribboned carrots and chickpeas in a warm cumin dressing brightened with lemon and herbs.
steps: Peel the carrots into ribbons or coarsely grate them.
Warm the cumin and cinnamon in the olive oil for 30 seconds until fragrant, then take off the heat.
Whisk the lemon juice into the warm spiced oil.
Toss the carrots, drained chickpeas, and raisins with the dressing and season with salt.
Fold in the parsley and let sit 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Lentil and lemon soup
recipes.blurb: A bright, comforting red lentil soup finished with a generous squeeze of lemon.
steps: Heat the oil and soften the chopped onion and carrot for 6 minutes, then add the garlic, cumin, and turmeric.
Stir in the rinsed lentils and the broth and bring to a boil.
Lower to a simmer and cook until the lentils are completely soft, about 20 minutes.
Blend until smooth, or partially blend for more texture, then season with salt.
Stir in the juice of the lemon and serve with extra wedges.

recipes.name: Roasted tomato basil soup
recipes.blurb: Oven-roasted tomatoes blended into a deep, sweet soup with a swirl of fresh basil.
steps: Halve the tomatoes and quarter the onion, then toss with the garlic, oil, and salt on a sheet pan.
Roast at 425F for 35 minutes until soft and lightly charred.
Scrape everything into a pot, add the broth, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Blend until smooth, then stir in the cream and most of the basil.
Season to taste and serve topped with the remaining basil.

recipes.name: Minestrone
recipes.blurb: A rustic Italian vegetable soup loaded with beans, pasta, and whatever is in season.
steps: Heat the oil and soften the chopped onion, carrot, and celery for 8 minutes, then add the garlic and oregano.
Stir in the diced tomatoes and broth and bring to a simmer.
Add the diced zucchini and beans and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the pasta and cook until tender, about 10 minutes more.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.name: Creamy roasted carrot soup
recipes.blurb: Velvety roasted carrots blended with ginger and coconut milk for a naturally sweet bowl.
steps: Toss the peeled, chopped carrots and onion with oil and salt and roast at 425F for 30 minutes.
Transfer to a pot with the ginger, cumin, and broth and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add most of the coconut milk and blend until completely smooth.
Season to taste and reheat gently if needed.
Serve with a swirl of the remaining coconut milk.

recipes.name: Vegan corn chowder
recipes.blurb: A creamy, dairy-free chowder thick with sweet corn, potatoes, and smoky paprika.
steps: Heat the oil and soften the chopped onion for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and smoked paprika.
Add the diced potatoes, 3 cups of the corn, and the broth, and simmer until the potatoes are tender, about 15 minutes.
Blend about half the soup until smooth, then return it to the pot for a creamy but chunky texture.
Stir in the coconut milk and the remaining corn and warm through.
Season with salt and serve topped with sliced scallions.

recipes.name: Tuscan white bean and kale soup
recipes.blurb: A hearty, garlicky bean soup with tender kale and a Parmesan-rind depth.
steps: Heat the oil and soften the chopped onion and carrot for 8 minutes, then add the garlic and rosemary.
Add the broth, the drained beans, and the Parmesan rind, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Mash some of the beans against the side of the pot to thicken the broth.
Stir in the chopped kale and simmer until tender, about 8 minutes.
Remove the rind, season, and serve with grated Parmesan and a drizzle of oil.

recipes.name: Thai coconut soup
recipes.blurb: A fragrant tom kha with mushrooms, lemongrass, and lime in a silky coconut broth.
steps: Bruise the lemongrass stalks and simmer them with the ginger in the broth for 8 minutes to infuse.
Add the coconut milk and sliced mushrooms and simmer gently for 8 minutes.
Season with the soy sauce and the juice of both limes.
Fish out the lemongrass, then add sliced chili to taste.
Serve scattered with cilantro.

recipes.name: French onion soup
recipes.blurb: Deeply caramelized onions in a rich broth under bubbling, cheese-topped toast.
steps: Melt the butter and cook the thinly sliced onions over medium-low, stirring often, until deep golden brown, about 40 minutes.
Stir in the flour and thyme and cook 1 minute, then pour in the wine and scrape up the browned bits.
Add the broth and simmer for 20 minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Toast slices of baguette until crisp.
Ladle the soup into oven-safe bowls, top with the toast and grated Gruyere, and broil until the cheese is bubbling and golden.

recipes.name: Split pea soup
recipes.blurb: A thick, comforting bowl of split peas slow-simmered with carrots and smoky seasoning.
steps: Heat the oil and soften the chopped onion, carrot, and celery for 8 minutes, then add the garlic and smoked paprika.
Stir in the rinsed split peas, bay leaf, and broth and bring to a boil.
Lower to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until the peas break down and the soup is thick, about 50 minutes.
Discard the bay leaf and season generously with salt and pepper.
Blend a portion for a smoother texture if you like, then serve.

recipes.name: Butternut squash soup
recipes.blurb: Silky roasted squash soup with warming spices and a touch of apple sweetness.
steps: Toss the peeled, cubed squash with oil and salt and roast at 425F for 30 minutes until tender.
Soften the chopped onion in a pot for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, cinnamon, and nutmeg.
Add the roasted squash, chopped apple, and broth and simmer for 10 minutes.
Blend until completely smooth, adding broth to reach your preferred consistency.
Season to taste and serve.

recipes.name: Vegetable barley stew
recipes.blurb: A hearty, brothy stew of barley, root vegetables, and mushrooms for a cold evening.
steps: Heat the oil and brown the sliced mushrooms, then add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery and cook 8 minutes.
Stir in the garlic, thyme, and tomato paste and cook 2 minutes.
Add the rinsed barley and broth and bring to a boil.
Simmer until the barley is tender and the stew has thickened, about 40 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and serve.

recipes.name: Black bean soup
recipes.blurb: A smoky, satisfying black bean soup brightened with lime and ready in under an hour.
steps: Heat the oil and soften the chopped onion for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, cumin, and smoked paprika.
Add two cans of the beans with their liquid and the broth and simmer for 10 minutes.
Blend the soup until mostly smooth, then return it to the pot.
Stir in the remaining can of drained beans and warm through for a chunky texture.
Season with salt and lime juice and serve topped with cilantro.

recipes.name: Apple crumble
recipes.blurb: Tender cinnamon-spiced apples under a buttery, golden oat crumble.
steps: Heat the oven to 375F and peel, core, and slice the apples into a baking dish.
Toss the apples with half the brown sugar, the cinnamon, and a squeeze of lemon.
Rub the butter into the flour and oats with the remaining sugar until crumbly.
Scatter the crumble evenly over the apples.
Bake for 40 minutes until the topping is golden and the fruit is bubbling at the edges.
Cool slightly and serve warm.

recipes.name: Chocolate chip cookies
recipes.blurb: Chewy-centered, crisp-edged cookies loaded with pools of melted chocolate.
steps: Heat the oven to 375F and line two baking sheets with parchment.
Cream the softened butter with both sugars until light and fluffy.
Beat in the eggs and vanilla, then mix in the flour, baking soda, and salt until just combined.
Fold in the chocolate chips.
Scoop tablespoon-sized mounds onto the sheets, spacing them well apart.
Bake for 9 to 11 minutes until the edges are golden but the centers look soft, then cool on the sheet for 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Vegan chocolate avocado mousse
recipes.blurb: An impossibly silky chocolate mousse made entirely from ripe avocado and cocoa.
steps: Scoop the avocado flesh into a food processor.
Add the cocoa powder, maple syrup, vanilla, almond milk, and salt.
Blend until completely smooth, scraping down the sides as needed.
Add a splash more almond milk if it is too thick.
Spoon into glasses and chill for at least 30 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Lemon bars
recipes.blurb: Bright, tangy lemon curd set over a buttery shortbread base and dusted with powdered sugar.
steps: Heat the oven to 350F and line an 8-inch pan with parchment.
Rub the butter into 1.25 cups of the flour with the powdered sugar to form a crumbly dough, then press into the pan.
Bake the base for 20 minutes until pale golden.
Whisk the eggs, sugar, the remaining flour, and the juice and zest of the lemons into a smooth filling.
Pour the filling over the warm crust and bake for another 22 minutes until just set.
Cool completely, then dust with powdered sugar and cut into squares.

recipes.name: Banana bread
recipes.blurb: A moist, tender loaf made with very ripe bananas and a hint of cinnamon.
steps: Heat the oven to 350F and grease a loaf pan.
Mash the bananas, then mix in the melted butter, sugar, eggs, and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking soda, and cinnamon until just combined.
Pour into the loaf pan and smooth the top.
Bake for 55 to 60 minutes until a skewer comes out clean, then cool in the pan for 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Mixed berry crumble
recipes.blurb: Juicy summer berries baked under a crisp almond-oat topping.
steps: Heat the oven to 375F and tip the berries into a baking dish with a squeeze of lemon and 2 tablespoons of the sugar.
Mix the oats, flour, almonds, and remaining sugar in a bowl.
Pour in the melted coconut oil and stir until the mixture clumps.
Scatter the topping over the berries.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes until the top is golden and the fruit is bubbling, then cool slightly.

recipes.name: Flourless chocolate cake
recipes.blurb: A dense, fudgy, naturally gluten-free chocolate cake with a glossy crackled top.
steps: Heat the oven to 350F and line the bottom of an 8-inch springform pan with parchment.
Melt the chocolate and butter together until smooth, then let cool slightly.
Whisk in the sugar, then beat in the eggs one at a time.
Stir in the cocoa powder, vanilla, and salt until glossy and smooth.
Pour into the pan and bake for 25 minutes until the top is set but the center is still slightly soft.
Cool completely before releasing from the pan.

recipes.name: Peanut butter no-bake bars
recipes.blurb: Chewy oat and peanut butter bars set in the fridge with a chocolate top, no oven needed.
steps: Warm the peanut butter and maple syrup together until smooth, then stir in the vanilla and salt.
Mix in the oats until evenly coated, then press firmly into a parchment-lined 8-inch pan.
Melt the chocolate chips with the coconut oil and spread over the top.
Chill for at least 1 hour until firm.
Lift out and cut into bars.

recipes.name: Poached pears in spiced wine
recipes.blurb: Whole pears gently poached until ruby-tinged in a fragrant spiced red wine syrup.
steps: Peel the pears, leaving the stems intact, and trim the bases so they stand upright.
Combine the wine, sugar, cinnamon, star anise, and strips of orange peel in a pot and bring to a simmer.
Lay the pears on their sides in the liquid and poach gently, turning occasionally, until tender, about 25 minutes.
Remove the pears and simmer the liquid until reduced to a syrup, about 10 minutes.
Serve the pears upright with the spiced syrup spooned over.

recipes.name: Carrot cake
recipes.blurb: A spiced, moist carrot cake crowned with tangy cream cheese frosting.
steps: Heat the oven to 350F and grease two 9-inch cake pans.
Whisk the eggs, sugar, and oil until smooth, then stir in the flour, baking soda, and cinnamon.
Fold in the grated carrots and chopped walnuts.
Divide between the pans and bake for 30 to 35 minutes until a skewer comes out clean, then cool completely.
Beat the cream cheese with the powdered sugar until smooth and spread between and over the layers.

recipes.name: Sticky toffee pudding
recipes.blurb: A date-sweetened sponge drenched in warm toffee sauce, best served with cream.
steps: Heat the oven to 350F and grease a baking dish. Simmer the chopped dates in 1 cup water for 5 minutes, then stir in the baking soda and let cool.
Cream half the butter with half the brown sugar, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Fold in the flour, then stir in the date mixture, and pour into the dish.
Bake for 30 minutes until risen and firm to the touch.
Meanwhile, melt the remaining butter and sugar with the cream and simmer for 3 minutes to make the toffee sauce.
Pour some sauce over the warm pudding and serve the rest alongside.

recipes.name: Maple roasted root vegetables
recipes.blurb: Caramelized carrots, parsnips, and beets glazed with maple and finished with thyme.
steps: Heat the oven to 425F and cut all the vegetables into even chunks.
Toss them with the oil, smashed garlic, thyme, and a good pinch of salt on a sheet pan.
Roast for 25 minutes, stirring once.
Drizzle with the maple syrup, toss, and roast for another 12 to 15 minutes until caramelized and tender.
Serve hot.

recipes.name: Lemon herb rice pilaf
recipes.blurb: Fluffy, fragrant rice toasted in butter and brightened with lemon and fresh herbs.
steps: Melt the butter and soften the finely chopped onion for 4 minutes, then add the garlic.
Stir in the rinsed rice and toast for 2 minutes until the grains turn translucent at the edges.
Pour in the broth, bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on low for 15 minutes.
Turn off the heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Stir in the lemon zest, a squeeze of lemon juice, and the parsley before serving.
